Pakistan Minister Threatens India Over Indus Waters Treaty

A Pakistani minister has issued a threat to India regarding the Indus Waters Treaty, stating that any attempt to obstruct water flow would be met with severe retaliation. The minister emphasized Pakistan's commitment to securing its share of water under the treaty. This exchange occurs amidst ongoing tensions between the two nations over water resources.
